collection.title: Ford S-Max 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford S-Max 2019 Onwards is fitted with a new type of wiper blade called the 'AquaBlade'. This unique type of wiper, developed by Valeo, delivers wiper fluid directly onto the windscreen through the wiper blade. The drivers side requires a 30" and a 29" for the passengers side. We also have rear blades for this model, please click on the Rear Blades tab.
